# HR & Admin Optimization Directives

This document outlines critical actions for the HR & Admin department:

*   Monitor the bonus structure based on audit findings.
*   Urgently optimize the bonus structure.
*   Investigate updates to the bonus structure standard.
*   Optimize annual leave quarterly.
*   Optimize the bonus structure based on audit requirements.
